title: Create: Crushed Concrete
description:
Allows the ability to crush all vanilla concrete into concrete powder for the off chance you accidentally turn one too many into concrete.

From Dense to dust jiffy quick!
body:
## Turning dense to dust, jiffy quick!

Allows concrete to be crushed into concrete powder. Made for the intention of adding a powder element from the concrete generation mechanic from [Create: Dragons Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dragons-plus)

I probably won't update past this as I am NOT a datapack developer by any means.

![How to use the crushing wheels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f361c3bdcdea1830d6150435e123eb0e0a2b3bc5.png)
